summary: Implemented print_json per the spec. Changes: rich/highlighter.py adds JSONHighlighter (base style "json.", one combined pattern: brace, literals, number, str). rich/default_styles.py adds the six json.* keys. rich/json.py adds the JSON renderable (parse, re-serialize with indent, highlight or NullHighlighter, no_wrap=True, overflow=None, __rich__ returns the Text) and a __main__ CLI with a required PATH argument, soft_wrap printing, and "Unable to read" errors to stderr with exit -1. rich/console.py adds Console.print_json after print, importing JSON lazily. rich/__init__.py adds package-level print_json after print and before inspect; __all__ is unchanged. Tests added: test_print_json in tests/test_console.py (exact truecolor expected output) and test_rich_print_json in tests/test_rich_print.py; no existing tests modified. Docs: "Printing JSON" section in docs/source/console.rst, new docs/source/reference/json.rst linked from reference.rst, and a changelog line under Unreleased Added. Not run, per instructions: the test expectations were derived by reading the style and rendering code. Choices: overflow=None (Python None, not the string "none"); the CLI's __main__ block imports Console, which the renderable module itself does not. Nothing committed.
